tools.live_help:
read: TurboMCP.TurboMCPEditToolset.EditTurboMCPMenuActivate
kind: Edit   source: TurboMCP
what: Request activation of one named runtime button through normal Slate input.
parameters: 2
  target: string [required] - Required exact string pie:0. Standalone, multiplayer and other targets refuse.
  widget: string [required] - Required exact runtime object path or unique object name from ReadTurboMCPPlayInputState. Not a designer name, display label, asset path or Slate ref. Prefer the complete runtime path when names repeat. Workflow: read current state, select its runtime button path, call once, allow normal frames for press/release, then read state and capture the viewport. A disabled/hidden/ambiguous button refuses. If focus moves but input fails, the error says so. Never retry blindly after an uncertain client outcome.
